Devil.Content:
Order and chaos clashed, while the origins of the alternate timeline remained unclear.
    The outcome had been decided, but a mysterious force held it frozen in place.
    It was a "gaze" that pierced dimensions, intervening unnoticed, leaving behind neither name nor trace.

    Orthros aimed to repair, while Zolrath sought to control—yet both were ultimately denied.
    In the end they finally realized the truth: that from the very beginning, this timeline had never belonged to their dimension.

    Yet from their clash, a mysterious "anchor point" had emerged.
    A figure capable of moving between both timelines, unnoticed and unperturbed.
    And perhaps that might be the key to the real truth.

    The rift in the timeline has healed for the moment, but the deviation persists, and the conflict continues unabated.
    The real answer, the real truth remains hidden in the timeline that doesn't belong to this world.

    Thus, the final outcome remains in limbo.
